table.retrieve:
SELECT
	AliasName = (SELECT A.AliasName FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = T.Suppcode),
	SupplierName = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = T.Suppcode),
	Type=T.Type,
	Customer=T.Customer,
	Patient=T.Patient,
	ServiceCode=S.ServiceCode,
	ServiceName=S.Name,
	ServicePurInvCode=T.ServicePurInvCode,
	ServiceInvCode=T.ServiceInvCode,
	Date=T.Date,
	PurQty = SUM(T.PurQty),
	PurValue = SUM(PurValue),
	SaleQty= SUM(T.SaleQty),
	SaleValue = SUM(T.SaleValue),
	Profit = SUM(T.SaleValue) - SUM(PurValue),
	ProfitPerc = ((SUM(T.SaleValue) - SUM(PurValue)) / CASE WHEN SUM(T.SaleValue) > 0 THEN SUM(T.SaleValue) ELSE 1 END) * 100
FROM
	Service S,
	(SELECT 
		Type='RS',
		ServicePurInvCode=SP.ServicePurInvCode,
		ServiceInvCode=SP.ServiceInvCode,
		SuppCode = SP.SuppCode,
		Customer=(SELECT A.Name + ' (' + A.AliasName + ')' FROM Accounts A, ServiceHeader SH WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode = SP.ServiceInvCode AND SH.CustCode = A.AccCode),
		Patient=(SELECT P.Name + ' (' + P.RegNo + ')' FROM Patient P, ServiceHeader SH  WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode = SP.ServiceInvCode AND P.PatientCode=SH.PatientCode),
		Date=SP.Date,
		ServiceCode=S.ServiceCode,
		PurQty = SUM(SPD.Qty),
		PurValue = ROUND(SUM(SPD.Qty * (SPD.Price - SPD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SPD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2),
		SaleQty = (SELECT SUM(SD.Qty) FROM ServiceInvPurTempDetail SD WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode = SP.ServiceInvCode AND SPD.SrvRowID = SD.SrvRowID AND SD.ServiceCode=SPD.ServiceCode),
		SaleValue = (SELECT ROUND(SUM(SD.Qty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) FROM ServiceInvPurTempDetail SD WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode = SP.ServiceInvCode AND SPD.SrvRowID = SD.SrvRowID AND SD.ServiceCode=SPD.ServiceCode)
	FROM
		Supplier SUP, Accounts A, ServicePurHeader SP, ServicePurDetail SPD, Service S
	WHERE
		S.ServiceCatCode IN (:ai_servicecode) AND
		S.ServiceCode = SPD.ServiceCode AND
		SPD.ServicePurInvCode = SP.ServicePurInvCode AND 
		SP.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
		SP.SuppCode = SUP.SuppCode AND
		SUP.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
		SUP.SuppCode = A.AccCode
	GROUP BY
		SP.ServicePurInvCode,
		SP.ServiceInvCode,
		SP.Date,
		SP.SuppCode,
		S.ServiceCode,
		SPD.ServiceCode,
		SPD.SrvRowID) T
WHERE
	S.ServiceCode = T.ServiceCode
GROUP BY
	T.ServicePurInvCode,
	T.ServiceInvCode,
	T.Type,
	T.Date,
	T.Suppcode,
	T.Customer,
	T.Patient,
	S.ServiceCode,
	S.Name
table.sort: aliasname A, suppliername A, servicename A
